ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (dark) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface; high contrast transition localized at distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous regions at the distal tips. Left lobe: elongated wedge starting at the tip and tapering inward. Right lobe: broader irregular white patch containing detached high-intensity pixel islands extending toward the fluke center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 52 degrees; depth extends approximately 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth peaks along the entire boundary. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits 6-8 prominent vertical pixel variations (peaks), while the left lobe shows a more uniform, lower-amplitude serration pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on leading edges meeting at acute, upward-oriented tips; trailing edge displays a macro-concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular white pixel groups localized on the trailing margins of the white distal patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, light-grey linear tracks (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally, disrupting the low-intensity central pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jagged wear and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense overlapping linear scarification across the central dark region.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique detached 'splatter' pigmentation pattern on the interior border of the right-side white patch, separated from the main high-intensity mass by dark pixels.
